name: GradientCard
description: A card component with configurable gradient borders using a three-layer system. Supports named presets or custom configurations for light and dark modes. Built with the Cardopia gradient system.
usage: Use named presets ('elevated', 'inset', 'matts') for quick styling
Provide custom lightConfig/darkConfig for full control over gradients
Automatically switches between light and dark mode configurations
Use href prop to render as a clickable link
Combine with other Card sub-components for complex layouts
examples:
```tsx // Using a preset import { GradientCard } from '@/lib/designsystem';

Elevated Card

Appears to float above the surface

 ```

```tsx // As a link

Clickable Card

 ```

```tsx // Without hover effect
Static Card
 ```
design: Three-layer gradient system: borderBottom → borderTop → surface
Border layers fade to transparent for natural alpha blending
Surface layer uses solid gradient fill
Presets match Cardopia tool output for consistency
Uses CSS custom properties for efficient theme switching
Shadow on hover disabled by default (configurable)
Surface indices 0-25 map to design system surface ramp
accessibility: When used with href, renders as a proper Next.js Link for navigation
Focus and hover states are visually indicated via shadow changes
Ensure sufficient color contrast between border and surface colors

props.name: href
props.description: Link destination - renders as Next.js Link when provided
